name: Can disability and accessibility modifications be incorporated into restoration projects?

mainEntity.name: Can disability and accessibility modifications be incorporated into restoration projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, accessibility modifications can be integrated smoothly during restoration remodeling. When rebuilding damaged bathrooms, kitchens, or living spaces, contractors can reframe doorways for wheelchair clearance, lower countertop heights, and reinforce wall studs for grab bar support before new drywall is hung. In bathrooms, replacing damaged tubs with zero-threshold tile showers creates barrier-free access. Incorporating universal design features during an active repair saves money and avoids the mess of tearing into finished walls a second time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Damage repairs offer an ideal opportunity to widen doors, reinforce wall framing for grab bars, and build zero-threshold tile showers during the construction phase.
